_comment: Which shard each wishlist weapon is built from, and how many it takes. Sources are listed in page order. A source's weapons come from archbossWeapons.json except where `weapons` is given here (Heroic, which no archboss drops). `snowsoul`, where present, is the shard for that boss's Snowsoul weapons (any weapon whose name contains "Snowsoul"); every other weapon of the source uses `shard`. Both the Shards page and PUT /api/shards read this file.
